## Project Overview
Full-stack Project Management Application (Phase 1)

### Stack
- Frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js + Express + Prisma ORM
- Database: PostgreSQL

### Completed Features
- Database connection and models (User, Project, Task, Comment)
- JWT authentication (register/login)
- Dashboard with statistics
- Project management CRUD operations

### Development Commands
- `npm run dev` - Run both client and server
- `npm run dev:server` - Server only (port 4000)
- `npm run dev:client` - Client only (port 5173)

### Code Style Guidelines
- Use modern JavaScript (ES6+)
- Tailwind for styling (utility-first)
- Clean, minimal UI with soft shadows
- Mobile-responsive design

### Next Phase Features (Not Yet Implemented)
- Task Management CRUD
- Comments and collaboration
- Activity logs
- Advanced analytics
